headline: California order seeks expert advice on a kill switch for frontier AI
summary: Both reports describe an executive order from California's governor directing the state to convene experts on AI safety, including the possibility of mandating a kill switch for frontier models. One adds that the panel is to report within two months and that the order positions the state to lead on AI oversight. Nothing in the two texts conflicts.
